facts.text: Deborah's mother passed away a few years ago, and the photo of two women in wheelchairs is their last together.

evidence.quote: It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together.

facts.text: Deborah's mother had a special bench near the window in her house, which she loved to sit in every morning.

evidence.quote: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view.

facts.text: Deborah has a pendant that reminds her of her mother, similar to Jolene's pendant which was given to her in Paris in 2010.

evidence.quote: Do you have something to remember her by? This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010 in Paris.
Yes, I also have a pendant that reminds me of my mother.

facts.text: Jolene's pendant has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for her, reminding her to pursue her goals.

evidence.quote: It has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for me. It's a nice reminder to go for my goals and not get held back.
